title: Truncated simplicial objects, skeleton and coskeleton
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category and $m\geq0$. Let $\Delta_{\leq m}$ be the full subcategory of $\Delta$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] on the objects $[0],\dots,[m]$. An *$m$-truncated simplicial object* of $\mathcal C$ is a functor $V:\Delta_{\leq m}^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$, and a morphism of $m$-truncated simplicial objects is a natural transformation. The *$m$-skeleton* $\mathrm{sk}_mK$ of a simplicial object $K$ of $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] is its restriction to $\Delta_{\leq m}^{\mathrm{op}}$; with the restriction of morphisms this is a functor $\mathrm{sk}_m$ from simplicial objects to $m$-truncated simplicial objects. For an $m$-truncated simplicial object $V$, an *$m$-coskeleton of $V$* is a simplicial object $\mathrm{cosk}_mV$ together with a morphism $\varepsilon:\mathrm{sk}_m\mathrm{cosk}_mV\to V$ of $m$-truncated simplicial objects such that for every simplicial object $U$ of $\mathcal C$ the map $h\mapsto\varepsilon\circ\mathrm{sk}_m(h)$ is a bijection from morphisms $U\to\mathrm{cosk}_mV$ of simplicial objects to morphisms $\mathrm{sk}_mU\to V$; we say $\mathrm{cosk}_mV$ *exists* if such a pair exists. For a simplicial object $K$ such that $\mathrm{cosk}_m\mathrm{sk}_mK$ exists, the *canonical morphism* $K\to\mathrm{cosk}_m\mathrm{sk}_mK$ is the morphism corresponding to $\mathrm{id}_{\mathrm{sk}_mK}$ under this bijection.
